title: We, you all, they: setting groups side by side

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: When two groups do different things, say the pronouns, because now they matter: *Mi főzünk, ők pihennek.* Each verb takes the ending of its own group. This is the same use of the pronoun as *Én főzök, te olvasol* in unit 13.

items.english: In the morning we study, they walk.
We have lunch, but they do sport.

sections.content: If you leave out the pronouns, the sentence still works: *Főzünk, pihennek.* But the contrast is clearer with *mi* and *ők*.
